dialogues.jp: （やっばぁ――っ！）
dialogues.en: "(Craaaap!)"
dialogues.text: "(Craaaap!)"

dialogues.jp: 心の中で雄叫びを上げつつ、家を飛び出す。
dialogues.en: My mind roared, as I flew out of the house.
dialogues.text: My mind roared, as I flew out of the house.

dialogues.jp:
音夢においてかれ遅刻寸前の俺は、通学路を疾
走する。
dialogues.en:
Chasing Nemu and on the verge of lateness, I dashed on the
path to school.
dialogues.text:
Chasing Nemu and on the verge of lateness, I dashed on the
path to school.

dialogues.jp:
交差点を斜めに渡り、自転車を追い抜き、最短
を確保しつつコーナーを曲がる。
dialogues.en:
Slanting in one direction at an intersection while passing a
bicycle, I turned the corner to the shortest route.
dialogues.text:
Slanting in one direction at an intersection while passing a
bicycle, I turned the corner to the shortest route.

dialogues.jp: コンマ１秒の戦い。
dialogues.en: A battle of microseconds.
dialogues.text: A battle of microseconds.

dialogues.jp: これぞノンストップアクション！
dialogues.en: This will have to be non-stop action all the way there!
dialogues.text: This will have to be non-stop action all the way there!

dialogues.jp: 前方から、楽器の音が聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en: The sound of a musical instrument could be heard ahead.
dialogues.text: The sound of a musical instrument could be heard ahead.

dialogues.jp:
見ると、本校の制服を着た女の子が前をフラフ
ラと歩いていた。
dialogues.en:
Getting a better look, it is a girl wearing the uniform of
the main school, tottering her way towards it.
dialogues.text:
Getting a better look, it is a girl wearing the uniform of
the main school, tottering her way towards it.

dialogues.jp: 「……余裕だな」
dialogues.en: "...She sure is calm."
dialogues.text: "...She sure is calm."

dialogues.jp: 諦めたのか？
dialogues.en: Has she given up already?
dialogues.text: Has she given up already?

dialogues.jp:
驚かせないよう少し距離をとりつつ、その学生
の脇を駆け抜ける。
dialogues.en:
Slowing my pace to make sure I don't frighten her, I ease
past her from her side.
dialogues.text:
Slowing my pace to make sure I don't frighten her, I ease
past her from her side.

dialogues.jp: 追い越す瞬間、ちらりと横を見――
dialogues.en: As I passed her by, I took a casual glance to my side--
dialogues.text: As I passed her by, I took a casual glance to my side--

dialogues.jp:
何故か女の子は目を｛つむ／瞑｝り、小さな木琴を叩きな
がら歩いていた。
dialogues.en:
The girl was walking with her eyes closed, all the while
playing a small xylophone rhythmically.
dialogues.text:
The girl was walking with her eyes closed, all the while
playing a small xylophone rhythmically.

dialogues.jp: （……Ｗｈａｔ？）
dialogues.en: "...What?"
dialogues.text: "...What?"

dialogues.jp:
思わず後ろを振り返りそうになるが、このスピー
ドでそれは洒落にならないので、思いとどまる。
dialogues.en:
I unconciously turned my head backwards, staring at the girl
with thoughts transfixed, as my speed fell dramatically.
dialogues.text:
I unconciously turned my head backwards, staring at the girl
with thoughts transfixed, as my speed fell dramatically.

dialogues.jp:
そのまま走り抜け、なんとか本鈴前に教室に飛
び込むと、そのまま床に這いつくばる。
dialogues.en:
I finally ran through the door to class, creeping to my desk
and trying to settle down.
dialogues.text:
I finally ran through the door to class, creeping to my desk
and trying to settle down.

dialogues.jp: （タイムは！？）
dialogues.en: "(What's the time!?)"
dialogues.text: "(What's the time!?)"

dialogues.jp: 教室の時計を見上げる。
dialogues.en: I looked upwards at the classroom's clock.
dialogues.text: I looked upwards at the classroom's clock.

dialogues.en: 8:15 AM (5 minutes, 48.29 seconds)
dialogues.text: 8:15 AM (5 minutes, 48.29 seconds)

dialogues.jp: 宇宙新？
dialogues.en: An alternate dimension?
dialogues.text: An alternate dimension?

dialogues.jp: 何故か本鈴まで５分もある。
dialogues.en:
For some reason, there's still 5 minutes before the bell
rings...
dialogues.text:
For some reason, there's still 5 minutes before the bell
rings...

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おはようございます、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, nii-san."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, nii-san."

dialogues.jp: 音夢がすました笑顔で近づいてくる。
dialogues.en: Nemu approached with a calm smile.
dialogues.text: Nemu approached with a calm smile.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁはぁ……はぁ……はぁ……？」
dialogues.en: "Haah haah... Haah... Haah... ?"
dialogues.text: "Haah haah... Haah... Haah... ?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「早起きは三文の得。今度からは、ちゃんと起
　きて下さいね」
dialogues.en:
"The early bird gets the worm. From now on, you really
should wake up early."
dialogues.text:
"The early bird gets the worm. From now on, you really
should wake up early."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はぁ……ね、音夢……はぁはぁ……？」
dialogues.en: "Haah... Ne... Nemu... Haah haah...?"
dialogues.text: "Haah... Ne... Nemu... Haah haah...?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ朝倉。随分とへばってるな？」
dialogues.en: "Completely exhausted eh, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Completely exhausted eh, Asakura?"

dialogues.jp:
音夢に続いて、来なくていいのに杉並も寄って
くる。
dialogues.en: Following after Nemu, Suginami arrived.
dialogues.text: Following after Nemu, Suginami arrived.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁはぁ……はぁ……は……」
dialogues.en: "Haah haa... Haah... Hah..."
dialogues.text: "Haah haa... Haah... Hah..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まだ本鈴まで５分あるんだから、なにもそん
　なになるまで全力で走らんでも、良かったん
　じゃないのか？」
dialogues.en:
"You just about got here 5 minutes early with your top
speed. That's pretty good!"
dialogues.text:
"You just about got here 5 minutes early with your top
speed. That's pretty good!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「はぁはぁ……い……いや……でも……」
dialogues.en: "Haah haah... w...wait... but..."
dialogues.text: "Haah haah... w...wait... but..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「い、家を出たときは…はぁ……マジやばかっ
　たんだって……」
dialogues.en:
"W, when I left the house... Haah... I didn't think I could
make it..."
dialogues.text:
"W, when I left the house... Haah... I didn't think I could
make it..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あの、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Erm, nii-san."
dialogues.text: "Erm, nii-san."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どうした、朝倉妹よ」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What's wrong, younger sister Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What's wrong, younger sister Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さんの部屋の時計、５分進んでましたので、
　直しておいていただけませんか？」
dialogues.en:
"Did you remember to fix your clock? The one that's set 5
minutes in advance?"
dialogues.text:
"Did you remember to fix your clock? The one that's set 5
minutes in advance?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それでは、お願いしますね」
dialogues.en: "Well then, if you would."
dialogues.text: "Well then, if you would."

dialogues.jp:
音夢はニッコリ微笑むと、自分の席に戻っていっ
た。
dialogues.en: With a sweet smile, Nemu returned to her desk.
dialogues.text: With a sweet smile, Nemu returned to her desk.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「さすがは朝倉妹よ」
dialogues.en: "As expected of younger sister Asakura."
dialogues.text: "As expected of younger sister Asakura."

dialogues.jp: 「……バタンクー」

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「南無阿弥陀仏」
dialogues.en: "I sincerely believe in Amitabha, Lord have mercy on me."
dialogues.text: "I sincerely believe in Amitabha, Lord have mercy on me."

dialogues.jp: ほっとけ。
dialogues.en: ...Stop it.
dialogues.text: ...Stop it.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なに、いつも通りということさ」
dialogues.en: "Oh well, guess everything's normal anyway."
dialogues.text: "Oh well, guess everything's normal anyway."

dialogues.jp: いつもこんな仕打ちを受けたら、たまらんぞ。
dialogues.en: Receiving this crap all the time, it's almost unbearable.
dialogues.text: Receiving this crap all the time, it's almost unbearable.

dialogues.jp:
杉並の奴め、この軽薄さとノリで、実は学年トッ
プの成績なんだから、世の中、間違ってるよな。
dialogues.en:
That Suginami, even though he acts so casual all the time,
he's actually has the top marks of the class, a blip in
society.
dialogues.text:
That Suginami, even though he acts so casual all the time,
he's actually has the top marks of the class, a blip in
society.

dialogues.jp: しかも運動も球技全般ＯＫときてる。
dialogues.en: Even worse, he's good at pretty much all sports.
dialogues.text: Even worse, he's good at pretty much all sports.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ところで朝倉。素晴らしい企画があるのだが、
　お前も参加せんか？」
dialogues.en:
"By the way Asakura, I've come up with a magnificent
project. You'd participate in it, of course?"
dialogues.text:
"By the way Asakura, I've come up with a magnificent
project. You'd participate in it, of course?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「くだらない企画の間違いじゃないのか？」
dialogues.en: "Wouldn't it be more like a stupid project?"
dialogues.text: "Wouldn't it be more like a stupid project?"

dialogues.jp: いや、こいつの場合は断定できるだろう。
dialogues.en:
Whenever it's from this guy, it always seems like that's the
case.
dialogues.text:
Whenever it's from this guy, it always seems like that's the
case.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そんなことは無いぞ。『白河ことりが卒業ま
　でに何人に告白されるか？』という、素晴ら
　しいクイズ大会だ」
dialogues.en:
"Of course not. It's a quiz competition based on the
question "How many people will confess to Shirakawa Kotori
before graduation?""
dialogues.text:
"Of course not. It's a quiz competition based on the
question "How many people will confess to Shirakawa Kotori
before graduation?""

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……賭けの間違いじゃないのか？」
dialogues.en: "...What I said, in other words?"
dialogues.text: "...What I said, in other words?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「何を言う。これはれっきとしたクイズ大会だ。
　むろん、正解者には豪華景品が進呈される」
dialogues.en:
"Not at all! Just look at the list of people who've already
signed up. The person with the correct answer is given a big
prize."
dialogues.text:
"Not at all! Just look at the list of people who've already
signed up. The person with the correct answer is given a big
prize."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: （豪華景品ねえ……）
dialogues.en: "(...Big prize, eh...)"
dialogues.text: "(...Big prize, eh...)"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「今のところ、一番人気は５０〜６０人といっ
　たところだな」
dialogues.en:
"Right now, the most popular range is around the 50-60
mark."
dialogues.text:
"Right now, the most popular range is around the 50-60
mark."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃ、凄いな」
dialogues.en: "That's amazing."
dialogues.text: "That's amazing."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「なんといっても、白河ことりだからな。俺は
　大穴で、１００人は越すのではないかと思っ
　ている」
dialogues.en:
"Nah, it's Shirakawa Kotori after all. I'm going for a dark
horse bet, I think 100 people will confess to her by then."
dialogues.text:
"Nah, it's Shirakawa Kotori after all. I'm going for a dark
horse bet, I think 100 people will confess to her by then."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.en: "100 people..."
dialogues.text: "100 people..."

dialogues.jp:
突拍子もない人数だが、彼女の人気を考えれば、
不可能な気がしない。
dialogues.en:
Even for that crazy amount of people, knowing her
popularity, I wouldn't say it's impossible...
dialogues.text:
Even for that crazy amount of people, knowing her
popularity, I wouldn't say it's impossible...

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「まったく、あんた達ってほんと、しょうがな
　いわね……」
dialogues.en: "Really, you two are hopeless..."
dialogues.text: "Really, you two are hopeless..."

dialogues.jp:
反対側を見上げると、クラスメイトの｛みずこし／水越｝｛まこ／眞子｝
がさげすむような目で、こちらを見ていた。
dialogues.en:
Looking up behind me, it's my classmate, Mizukoshi Mako,
glaring at us with scornful eyes.
dialogues.text:
Looking up behind me, it's my classmate, Mizukoshi Mako,
glaring at us with scornful eyes.

dialogues.jp:
「俺をこいつと一緒にするな眞子。俺はまとも
　だ」
dialogues.en: "I'm not with him, Mako. I'm an honest man."
dialogues.text: "I'm not with him, Mako. I'm an honest man."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「何を言う、Ｍｙ同志・朝倉。共に戦った仲で
　はないか」
dialogues.en:
"What are you saying, comrade Asakura. Are we not
comrades-in-arms, fighting the same battle?"
dialogues.text:
"What are you saying, comrade Asakura. Are we not
comrades-in-arms, fighting the same battle?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いつ、どこで、何を、どうやって、誰が、な
　ぜ」
dialogues.en: "When, where, what, how, who, why?"
dialogues.text: "When, where, what, how, who, why?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「先週、ゲーセンで、ゾンビ退治を、ガンを使っ
　て、俺とお前が、教授の野望を阻止するため
　に」
dialogues.en:
"Last week, the arcade center, zombie extermination, using
guns, you and I, to prevent the evil ambitions of the
teachers."
dialogues.text:
"Last week, the arcade center, zombie extermination, using
guns, you and I, to prevent the evil ambitions of the
teachers."

dialogues.speaker: Asakura & Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「同志よ」
dialogues.en: "Comrades."
dialogues.text: "Comrades."

dialogues.jp: がっちりと腕を組み合う。
dialogues.en: Our palms firmly met each other's.
dialogues.text: Our palms firmly met each other's.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……どっちもバカ」
dialogues.en: "...in stupidity."
dialogues.text: "...in stupidity."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ほら、席に着いて」
dialogues.en: "Alright, return to your seats."
dialogues.text: "Alright, return to your seats."

dialogues.jp:
本鈴と同時に、担任の白河暦先生が教室に入っ
て来た。
dialogues.en:
As the bell went off, the form teacher Shirakawa Koyomi
arrived at the classroom.
dialogues.text:
As the bell went off, the form teacher Shirakawa Koyomi
arrived at the classroom.

dialogues.jp: ◆謎の木琴少女◆
dialogues.en: ◆The Enigma of the Xylophone Girl◆
dialogues.text: ◆The Enigma of the Xylophone Girl◆

dialogues.jp:
ダッシュで学園に向かっている途中、目を｛つむ／瞑｝り
ながら木琴を叩く不思議な少女を見かける。
dialogues.en:
While dashing to school, a mysterious girl with her eyes
half-closed, rhythmically playing a xylophone, was seen.
dialogues.text:
While dashing to school, a mysterious girl with her eyes
half-closed, rhythmically playing a xylophone, was seen.

dialogues.jp:
少し気になったけど……遅刻寸前だったから、
そのまま通り過ぎた。
dialogues.en:
I was a bit worried for her, but I had enough on my plate,
and passed her by without disturbing her trance.
dialogues.text:
I was a bit worried for her, but I had enough on my plate,
and passed her by without disturbing her trance.

dialogues.jp:
余裕で教室に着き“世界新！”かと思いきや、
音夢のやつが時計を進めていただけだった……。
dialogues.en:
Reaching the "alternate dimension" school with time to
spare, Nemu told me about her adjustments to my clock...
dialogues.text:
Reaching the "alternate dimension" school with time to
spare, Nemu told me about her adjustments to my clock...
